description: This file contains interface definitions for streaming grains, their state classes, observer interfaces, and related method signatures used in Orleans streaming tests.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerGrain_State
classes.description: State class holding a list of producer observers for a streaming grain.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerGrain_State
classes.description: State class holding a list of consumer observers for a streaming grain.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerConsumerGrain_State
classes.description: State class holding lists of both producer and consumer observers.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Method to activate consumer behavior with stream details.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Method to deactivate consumer behavior.

methods.name: GetItemsConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of items consumed.

methods.name: GetConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the count of active consumers.

methods.name: DeactivateConsumerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates consumer when idle.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Method to activate producer behavior with stream details.

methods.name: RenewProducer
methods.description: Refreshes producer registration.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops the producer.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a series of items sequentially.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Produces a series of items in parallel.

methods.name: ProducePeriodicSeries
methods.description: Produces items periodically using a timer function.

methods.name: ExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Property to get expected number of items produced.

methods.name: ItemsProduced
methods.description: Property to get current number of items produced.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain by ID.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Gets the current number of producers.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Verifies that production or consumption has finished.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Method for consumer to start consuming a stream.

methods.name: RenewConsumer
methods.description: Refreshes consumer registration.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops consumer activity.

methods.name: ItemsConsumed
methods.description: Gets number of items consumed.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Gets count of consumers.

methods.name: ProviderName
methods.description: Name of the stream provider.
